name: boxing right hook
description: A right-handed hook punch thrown in a boxing stance. It trains rotation and power from the hips.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.
